respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture shows a next-generation Security Operations Center (SOC) built around Apache Metron on AWS. Ingestion sources (OnPremDC, S3, SNS, SQS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty) feed telemetry and log data into Apache Metron (ThirdParty). Metron sends data to EMR, which writes to an S3 security data lake, queried by Athena and fed back into Metron. Alerts are sent to an orchestration platform (Blitz) hosted on EC2, which coordinates with security analysts (UserCompanyAnalyst) and interacts bidirectionally with AWS WAF for remediation.
respuesta.nombre: Next-Gen Security Operations Center with Apache Metron on AWS
